_about: WP-58 Kéz: the risk class of every planned action. Order: own window → 'own'; elevated → 'elevated'; a password field, a blocked app or a blocked name → 'blocked' (never done); then the verb's class (with 'arg' for window). 'reversible' = the overlay may run it after a short visible countdown; 'confirm' = only after a spoken or typed 'igen'. A blocked name matches accent-folded and lower-case at the START of any word of the target's name ('torl' blocks 'Törlés' and 'Kosár törlése'); a two-word entry must appear as written. Edit freely; Voice/hands/hands.js reads this file at start.
_roles: Selecting a tab or a list item is reversible; invoking one (the same click) stays reversible too when the element is a tab.
_blockedApps: process names (without .exe) and process-name patterns that are never acted on: installers, the UAC and credential prompts, Windows Security, password managers, remote access, the registry and policy editors, disk tools.
_confirmApps: everything that is not blocked: invoke and toggle ask first; listed here only to make the default explicit.
